title: Bumblebee holding a heart
svg:

  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 92 C40 84 32 78 32 71 C32 65 37 62 42 64 C46 66 49 70 50 72 C51 70 54 66 58 64 C63 62 68 65 68 71 C68 78 60 84 50 92 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
